verdict.rationale: Canny documents an embeddable feedback widget for web and mobile, and its developer llms.txt is cut off at 'widget cu…', which may refer to widget customization. Nothing in the pack explicitly shows that the widget's label or colors can be changed to match a brand. missing for 10: explicit documentation of label customization, color/theme customization, brand-matching options, independent or hands-on corroboration.
